note: Harrison County's 280-acre water-supply lake north of Bethany, run by the county with MDC managing the fishery. Two camping areas, both marked on MDC's map: a small campground of gravel pull-ins under trees on the road past the boat ramp (W180 Lane), and primitive camping at the picnic point by the dam on the west road, beside the lake. --Claude
summary: County-run, not MDC: page 'This area is not owned by the Missouri Department of Conservation' and 'a small campground with water and electric hookups, primitive camp sites ... All facilities are maintained and managed by Harrison County'. Derived electric 0 / sewer false / $0 / FCFS cleared (MDC generic), water true, 14 nights (brochure), privies written. Two camps 680 m apart (west picnic point = pin; east pull-ins on W180 Lane). Lakefront not earned -> lakeview. Ownership looks local (flag). Phone matches MDC's line; the brochure names Harrison County 660-425-6424.
flags: OWNERSHIP / POLICY (state -> local): area page Rule 101: 'Chapter 12 of the Wildlife Code applies to this area. This area is not owned by the Missouri Department of Conservation ... For more information on any activity not listed below, contact the area owner'; 'The fishery is managed by the Missouri Department of Conservation (MDC) through a Community Assistance Program (CAP) agreement with Harrison County'; 'All facilities are maintained and managed by Harrison County.' The camping is the county's, so ownership local and policy_ref state:missouri-conservation-areas does not fit (MDC's free/FCFS/no-hookup defaults are wrong here: the county campground has water and electric). No Harrison County web page for the lake or its camping fees was found; aggregator listings (visitmo '$15 ... with hookups; $7 for primitive', undated; Campendium a reviewer's $15) were not used.

INCLUSION/FIT: map (04/16) legend 'Camping - Individual Campsites'; two symbols = GIS 578 (west picnic point by the dam, gravel loop and lot 2155) and 579 (east, gravel road past the ramp lot 891). Imagery: the east camp has 3-4 short gravel pull-in spurs on the east side of the road under the tree edge, one with a camper on it, beside a shelter house and the ramp/privy lots - the 'small campground'. The west point is a gravel loop round a shelter on open lawn with a small sand beach at its tip; no pads visible, camping would be on the gravel loop. Both are drive-in on gravel county roads; a 23-ft rig fits the gravel loop and lot; spur lengths look ~12-15 m. No horse camp, ford or rig wording.

WATERFRONT LEAD (lakefront -> lakeview): at the west point (the pin, GIS 578) the gravel loop/lot is ~35 m from the north shore, but the lawn between is the picnic area (map 'Picnic Area' at this lot) with the swim beach at the tip - day use between camp and water fails the open-apron rule, so lakefront is not earned; the water is in plain sight across open lawn, so lakeview holds. The east camp (579) is ~100 m from the lake through continuous forest - not waterfront.

PIN: stored 40.39793,-94.09034 = GIS 578, on the edge of the west point's gravel lot - fine as the lakeview camp. The east camp (the pull-in campground) is at GIS 579, 40.39823,-94.08234, 680 m east by its own gravel road (W180 Lane) - under 1 km, so no split; if AWH prefers the pin on the developed campground, move it to 40.39823,-94.08234 (and the waterfront then reads not waterfront for most sites).
CLUSTERS: two camps 680 m apart on separate gravel roads off W222 St; no split (under 1 km). near.py: nothing else in campgrounds.json within 3 km.

PHONE: area page 'For more information call (660) 646-6122' matches stored (MDC's line); the brochure gives MDC 816/675-2205 or 816/271-3100 and 'Harrison County 660/425-6424', and Rule 101 says to contact the area owner - 660-425-6424 is the county's number to consider for the campground.
SEASON (manual, year_round) left: its source is 3 CSR 10-11.115, but this is a Chapter 12 (not MDC-owned) area; neither page states a camping season.

MDC 2027 CAMPING PERMIT: MDC gave final approval (Oct. 23) to a $5 permit for up to five days of camping on MDC areas from March 2027 (https://mdc.mo.gov/node/307038); this area is county-owned and run, so whether it applies here is unknown - not written.
